result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears largely functional and well-structured. A few minor visual issues were found related to content truncation and horizontal scrolling cutoffs.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge, showing truncated text and a partial card.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for horizontal scroll carousels, but consider adding a subtle fade or peek indicator so users clearly understand more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated without an ellipsis, making it unclear the text is cut off versus part of the scroll.
issues.suggestion: Ensure full names display when scrolled into view, and use ellipsis truncation consistently for constrained text.

issues.description: The second item in 'Popular right now' (pizza card) is partially cut off at the bottom of the viewport, with its details not fully visible.
issues.suggestion: This is normal scroll behavior, but verify the card fully renders its title and metadata when scrolled into view.
